methods_quotes.q: Point estimates and 95% CIs were calculated, overall and by demographic characteristics
Comparisons of demographic characteristics and symptoms were performed using chi-square tests; p-values <0.05 were considered statistically significant.
All analyses were conducted using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute) and were weighted by sex, age group, region, race and ethnicity, and education.
Quota sampling and statistical weighting were used to align the sample with U.S. population distributions
